You don't need to write code to help here — describe it and we'll help get it in
(or you're welcome to open a pull request yourself; see CONTRIBUTING.md).

**What are you adding or correcting?**
- [ ] A real-world **precedent** for the Library (a parklet, plaza, green street, etc.)
- [ ] A new **curb element** for the catalog
- [ ] A **cost figure** or **source/citation**
- [ ] Other:

**Details**
- Name / title:
- Location and year (if a precedent):
- What it is / why it belongs:

**Source**
A link to the project, program, agency page, or study it comes from.

**Photo (for a precedent)**
If you have an image, note whether it's openly licensed (with the author +
license) or one you have permission to share.
